SSM.PasswordPrompt: Enter the table share password for SheetShare Mobile. It is used locally to encrypt the exported sheet and is not saved.

Settings.AutoExportHint: When enabled, published character sheets refresh after actor, item, or active effect changes while a GM browser has the share password in session.
Settings.HttpWarningHint: Show a storage test warning when the current Foundry page is not served over HTTPS.
Settings.ViewerLanguageHint: Controls the language of the mobile viewer interface. Character names, item names, spells, and descriptions still come from your Foundry world data.
Settings.ViewerLanguageAuto: Auto: use the player's browser language
Settings.AccessModeHint: Password mode is the safe default. External Auth writes trusted snapshots and must only be used when the viewer and assets are protected by your reverse proxy or portal authentication.
Settings.ExternalViewerEnabledHint: Foundry v14.361+ blocks static HTML pages from rendering, which breaks this module's normal mobile link. Enable this if you are running the included serve-viewer.js companion server, which serves the viewer page correctly and forwards everything else to Foundry.
Settings.ExternalViewerPortHint: Must match the VIEWER_PORT the serve-viewer.js companion server is running on (default 8321).
Settings.RollBridgeEnabledHint: Sends taps on the mobile viewer's ability/save/skill/attack rolls into Foundry as real rolls that appear in chat. Requires the external viewer server to be running and this Foundry tab to stay open - it works by polling the companion server from your own GM session, no extra login or account needed. Experimental - the exact roll method used depends on your dnd5e system version.

Manager.Intro: Published sheets are static snapshots served by Foundry's existing web server.
Manager.IntroPassword: Current access mode: password-protected encrypted snapshots.
Manager.IntroExternal: Current access mode: External Auth. Trusted snapshots must be served only behind your portal or reverse-proxy authentication.

Doctor.Title: SheetShare Mobile Doctor
Doctor.Intro: Check whether this world can publish and serve password-protected mobile sheets.
Doctor.HttpWarning: HTTP local/test mode. Public sharing should use HTTPS.
Doctor.LegacyInactive: No legacy sheet export module active.
Doctor.AccessModeExternal: External Auth enabled. Protect /modules/sheetshare-mobile/viewer and /assets/sheetshare-mobile before sharing links.
Doctor.ExternalViewerBadType: Reachable, but not serving HTML (got content-type: {contentType}). Check serve-viewer.js is running the latest version.
Doctor.ExternalViewerUnreachable: Could not reach the companion server on port {port} ({message}). Make sure serve-viewer.js (or start-viewer-electron.bat) is running.

MobileView.autoOpenHint: On this device only: skip straight to just your character sheet every time you log in, instead of Foundry's normal view. Turn this on from the phone/browser you actually use to play.
MobileView.forcedNoCharacter: The GM has set your account to always show Mobile View, but you don't have a character assigned yet - ask your GM to assign one.
MobileView.managerHint: Players checked here will have their canvas disabled and see only their character sheet, full screen, every time they log in - exactly like the old Foundry-first view, but forced on for them.
MobileView.managerNoPlayers: There are no non-GM players in this world yet.
